_comment: Layout of the floating combat HUD. Every number is in design pixels on a 1280x800 canvas.
The world is drawn to every window edge and no frame is drawn. bands: strips kept clear of the arena for the HUD
clusters; nothing paints them. The rest is the viewport the isometric arena is fitted into.
zones: [x, y, w, h] on the design canvas. The anchor names the screen edge a zone keeps its distance from
when the window is not exactly 16:10 (center = stays centered, right/bottom = moves with that edge).
Keep (1280 - min_width) / 2 design px of clearance between a center zone and its left/right neighbours:
narrowing the window moves right-anchored zones twice as far as centered ones.
turn_order, skills and end_turn are sized to their native art (hud_turnbar, hud_bar, hud_button).
